CareMind Health is a captive clinical services entity of Mindoula Health, Inc., and a national provider of virtual psychiatry and comprehensive behavioral health care services. As a patient-centered organization, we are focused on supporting people with their mental health. We create access to convenient, high quality services delivered by compassionate and skilled clinicians. Our goal is to provide our clients with an exceptional experience that improves overall well-being, and restores the foundations of healthy living. We customize and scale these services to provide comprehensive behavioral health solutions for hospitals and other healthcare partners throughout the country. With expertise across the care continuum, we can not only fix pain points that many of our partners encounter - such as provider coverage gaps and ED throughput delays - but also solve complex problems that will improve patient experience, drive outcomes, and lower total cost of care.

We launched Mindoula because each of us had personal experience with mental illness, either directly or through a loved one. We realized that the behavioral health system was broken and decided to take it upon ourselves to fix it by focusing on the people we serve, not their diagnoses or symptom sets. Each of us, and everyone we serve, is a person first and a set of challenges second.

The ideal candidate will have an entrepreneurial spirit, strong clinical operational experience, and thrive in a high-growth environment. They will roll up their sleeves, hire, train and support clinicians, partnering with a cross-functional team, as we grow both our inpatient and outpatient practices.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Overall administrative & scheduling responsibilities to support the growing CareMind Inpatient practice.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to initiate clinical new hire requests (as budgeted or approved) and draft employment exhibits for new providers during the hiring process.
* Collaborate with the business development team on staffing models for new inpatient programs.
* Partner with CareMind leadership to interview and recruit new APPs to the practice for inpatient roles.
* Partner with the provider credentialing team to ensure new providers are ready for their projected start date with all required EMR access and training completed.
* Submit required paperwork to kick-off new provider credentialing (CAARFs), and submit off-boarding paperwork for providers exiting the practice.
* Schedule and lead onboarding for new providers to all clinical sites, developing and refining training as needed to meet the needs of each part of the business and for each role.
* Train, coach, and ensure CareMind clinical team members understand established protocols to ensure positive clinical outcomes and operational excellence.
* Create MD and APP staff schedules for all inpatient programs to be released at least 90-days in advance and work with the payroll team to ensure providers are paid accurately.
* Manage provider PTO including review, approval and tracking for inpatient provider teams.
* Manage Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (“FPPE”) and Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (“OPPE”) processes for providers, including serving as proctor for reviews for APPs.
* In partnership with CareMind leadership, develop, manage, and ensure performance against practice outcome measures for CareMind overall and as required in specific contracts (e.g., including measure based care with PROMs).
* Coordinate with team members on new program and service rollouts to ensure timelines, deliverables, and communications are on track.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure appropriate monitoring and reporting on inpatient quality and performance, while supporting compliance with hospital service agreements and CareMind policies and procedures.
* Partner with colleagues, draft policies pertinent to provider operations to improve outcomes and increase efficiency of the CareMind practice.
* Work in a collegial and responsive manner with patients, clients, and colleagues to ensure high satisfaction with clinical services provided and facilitate client, patient and clinician retention.
* Perform other duties and projects as assigned to support the inpatient business.

**Education & Work Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree required in relevant field of study, Masters degree preferred.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

At Vida, we help people get better- and we're helping the healthcare system get better, too.

Vida is a virtual, personalized obesity care provider that uses evidence-based treatment to help patients manage obesity and related conditions like diabetes, high blood pressure, anxiety and depression. Vida's team of Obesity Medicine-Certified Physicians, Registered Dietitians, Expert Coaches and Licensed Therapists takes a whole-person approach to care, helping people lose weight, reduce stress and improve their overall health.

By combining advanced technology with top-notch healthcare providers, Vida is breaking down the barriers that have historically kept people from getting the best care. It's trusted by Fortune 100 companies, major national payers and large providers to enable their employees to live their healthiest lives.

Vida Health is looking for an Implementation Operations Manager to join our Client Success TechOps team. You will be the technical and operational point of contact for client implementation work between Vida and our clients and vendors — owning the full lifecycle of program changes, partner changes, and new client implementations from sales handoff through ongoing quality assurance and process improvement. You will also support broader implementation operations tasks such as configuration in Admin, B2B, & Command Center, billing file configuration, data exchange, and other critical deliverables required for new client launches.

You will work closely with Client Success Implementation Managers, Account Managers, Data Operations teams, Clinical Operations Leads, Client Technical teams, and Vida's Product & Engineering teams to ensure new and existing clients are reliably, accurately, and at scale. A key part of your work will happen in Vida's Client Command Center: Configure platform, and your insights will directly shape how we standardize and evolve our implementation practices.

* Execute Client Success led initiatives including documentation of the process, action plan and status on each item in the plan (e.g., issues, resolution and as well as client associated questions/responses).
* Track current and new client details as ongoing reference source.
* Align internal stakeholders, and drive progress on client-facing deliverables and issue resolutions.
* Map client data to internal schemas, run test loads, and perform QA to ensure high data quality and error-free ingestion.

* Source and align on requirements for program configuration alongside Product and Account Management stakeholders.
* Update operational tables and maintain changelogs for rule configuration changes.
* Implement billing workflows using Google Sheets, dbt, and SQL transformations.
* Configure pricing, billable items, engagement rules, and grace periods based on contract requirements.
* Validate end-to-end setup using dashboards and raw data pipelines.
* Deploy optimized program rules using custom Python scripts and Firestore.
* Partner with QA to validate member onboarding logic to ensure setup was implemented accurately.
* Coordinate with Product, Client Success, Engineering, and Analytics to ensure readiness across all launch-related workflows.
* Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Participate in continuous improvement efforts for tooling, templates, and SOPs.
* Serve as a liaison to key Client Success partners (e.g., Marketing, Reporting/Analytics, Product, Engineering) to enhance coordination and visibility into action plans and status of deliverables/priorities.
* Proactively optimize workflows to increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and scale repeatable processes.
* Additional responsibilities as needed.

* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, technical, or business field, or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years in data operations, analytics, health tech, or technical implementation.
* Experience in **digital health, health plans, employer benefits, or B2B SaaS client onboarding**.
* Familiarity with **healthcare data types**: eligibility, claims, pharmacy, lab, and prior authorization.
* Experience turning **contract terms into system configuration**, such as billing, SLAs, or performance guarantees.
* Experience working in a **HIPAA-regulated environment** with sound handling of protected health information.
* Past working examples of using scripting languages (e.g., Python) to automate and execute tasks is a major bonus.
* Critical thinking skills, ability to analyze data, identify gaps and risks and work with stakeholders, both internal and external, to create and implement recommendations for improvement.
* Must be a self-starter with the ability to work independently or in a team environment and have an ownership mentality.
* Must be organized and able to manage multiple tasks and apply good judgment in resolving complex, cross functional issues.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About UKON**

UKON exists to help every business survive a cyberattack.  
Formerly known as FifthWall Solutions, we have grown from our foundation as a specialized cyber insurance wholesaler into a full-service cyber revenue partner for independent insurance agencies and managed service providers. We give our partners the technology, processes, carrier access, and expertise they need to deliver sophisticated cyber capabilities without the cost and complexity of building an internal cyber department.  
Today, our team works inside our partners’ books of business to identify uninsured companies, understand their risk, secure the right coverage, and help get more businesses protected. With access to more than 50 carriers and differentiated coverage options, including custom endorsements for emerging risks such as agentic AI, we help businesses understand what they are buying and how their coverage will respond when they need it most.  
We are building the AI-native operating system that will make this work scalable. Our platform brings together fragmented agency data, cybersecurity context, carrier appetite, quoting, communications, and workflows to shorten the distance between an uninsured business and a protected one.  
For us, AI-native does not mean adding a chatbot to an existing product. It means embedding intelligence throughout the platform so the system can understand the context of a user’s work, recommend the right next action, and help complete that action within the workflow. Because we operate in insurance, we care as much about accuracy, reliability, auditability, data privacy, and user control as we do about model capability.  
Our mission is ambitious but simple: close the estimated $10 trillion cyber protection gap and ensure every business can survive a cyberattack.

**The Role**

You will be UKON's first Implementation Specialist, reporting to our executive team and working closely with our product, sales, and Cyber Practice Leaders (CPLs), teams. This is a greenfield role. You are being hired to build it.

Implementation turns a signed agreement into an active, growing agency relationship: getting the agency onboarded, trained, connected to their CPL, and producing. You will design the agency onboarding standard, the handoff from sales to CPLs, the training standards, and the implementation playbook, and then run them. You will decide what good looks like, measure it, and keep improving it. This starts as an individual contributor role, with the opportunity to own and grow the implementation function as UKON scales.

**WHO WE ARE**

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Cyera is seeking a Program Manager, Identity Security - Customer Success to design, own, and optimize scalable programs that help our customers adopt and get lasting value from Cyera’s identity security solutions. This role is a key interface between the Customer Success team, Product, and Sales Engineering, and will balance program management, content creation, and execution.

As identity becomes the control point for how people, machines, and AI agents access enterprise data, Customer Success teams need deep fluency in identity security and a repeatable way to bring customers to value. You’ll partner with Customer Success leadership, Product, Product Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to bring clarity, consistency, and creativity to onboarding, adoption, and readiness efforts. From CSE training tracks and customer onboarding programs to playbooks, presentation decks, and other materials, you’ll ensure that every asset is accurate, aligned to brand standards, and built for usability and visual polish.

This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong project ownership with a sharp design eye and a passion for helping customer-facing teams succeed through thoughtful, high-quality content and programming.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable Customer Success programs, including onboarding and adoption, across the identity security lifecycle.
* Own initiatives end to end, from concept and stakeholder alignment to content creation, delivery, and results tracking.
* Build readiness programs and learning paths that give CSMs working knowledge of identity security, including IAM, PAM, IGA, ITDR, and non-human and AI agent identities.
* Create clear, on-brand, visually engaging playbooks, presentations, and guides, and keep layout and branding consistent across formats.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Product Marketing, and Sales Engineering to align programs with priorities, messaging, and launches, and relay customer feedback and adoption blockers.
* Track and report on program metrics, such as onboarding time, adoption, and CSM readiness, and iterate on program design.
* Manage timelines, approvals, and dependencies, and support content QA and version control.

  
Requirements:  
  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 4+ years of experience in customer success, program management, enablement, or learning & development, preferably in cybersecurity or B2B SaaS.
* Proven track record designing and delivering programs that improve customer adoption or field performance.
* Working knowledge of identity security concepts, including IAM, IGA, PAM, SSO and MFA, and Zero Trust.
* Strong project and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated visual design ability and proficiency in Google Slides, Canva, PowerPoint, or Adobe Creative Suite.
* Excellent communication and editing skills, and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

**﻿**

Compensation Range: $100,000-$130,000

jobs.title: Senior Digital Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Mission:**

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

**Our People:**

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

**About the Role**

6sense is hiring a **Senior Digital Program Manager** to build and run the digital engagement engine for our Customer Success organization. This is a hybrid role: an expert-level Gainsight builder, program lead, and strategist. You will own the platform and, more importantly, You will own the platform and the quality of what gets built on it: the journeys, programs, and measurement that put CS strategy into action at scale. You are accountable for how they are built, for their accuracy, and for reporting on how they perform. Your primary focus will be to build and operate the digital programs that carry out CS strategy, report on where they are working and where customers are going unengaged, and recommend what to build next within CS priorities.

You will partner closely with CS Leadership, CS Operations, Marketing, Product, and Support. You are not a ticket-taker: you identify the gaps, propose the program, build it, launch it, and prove its impact.

**What This Role Is – And Isn't**

This role is for someone who has done this before and does not need a runway. We need a builder and program owner, not a resource waiting to be directed.

* **You move fast and ship.** Journeys launch in weeks, not months. We do not wait for perfect requirements; we iterate.
* **You lead, not just execute.** You do not wait for requests. You use data to find where customers are not being engaged, then bring a proposed program, a business case, and a plan.
* **You flag blockers immediately.** Unclear or missing requirements are raised the same day, with a recommendation attached.
* **You own your backlog.** You prioritize your own backlog and drive to resolution. We review outputs; we do not track status.
* **You know the difference between "I need input" and "I need permission."** Judgment calls within scope get made. Questions that need business context get escalated quickly.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Program Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and calendar for CS digital programs across the customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.
* Design and launch strategic, segment-level programs and journeys, aligned to customer segmentation, health scoring, and CS coverage models.
* Build the business case for each program: audience, objective, success metrics, content needs, and required resources. Prioritize the roadmap with CS Leadership.
* Act as project and program lead for cross-functional digital initiatives, coordinating Marketing, Product, Support, Sales, and Enablement to deliver on time.
* Pilot and evaluate new engagement channels and tactics (in-app, email, community, webinars, and others) and scale what works.

**Digital Journey & Campaign Build**

* Design and build automated journeys in Gainsight, including conditional logic, multi-step triggers, and data-driven audiences.
* Create, manage, and optimize email programs and in-app campaigns targeting customers at key lifecycle moments. Partner with Marketing and CS on messaging, and own campaign hygiene and governance.
* Build and maintain audience segments, rules, and triggers for digital touchpoints; connect digital programs to CTAs and human-led plays so digital and CSM engagement work together.
* A/B test content, timing, and cadence; report results and iterate.

**Engagement Coverage & Gap Analysis**

* Track engagement: which customers, segments, and lifecycle stages are receiving touches, and which are not.
* Identify and quantify gaps – unengaged accounts, stalled onboarding, low adoption, at-risk renewals with no digital or human outreach – and turn them into prioritized programs and recommendations.
* Maintain a clear view of program progress against plan, and present findings and next steps to CS Leadership on a regular cadence.

**Gainsight Platform** **Leader**

* Serve as the primary Gainsight Lead for Customer Success, owning building, data integrity, and platform health in regards to digital customer lifecycle.
* Ensure Snowflake, Salesfoce, and other connectors data ingestion into Gainsight is usable for customer lifecycle programs
* Document configurations, processes, and runbooks proactively.

**Reporting, Analytics & Insights**

* Build and maintain dashboards and reports for CS Leadership
* Track journey and program performance: reach, open and click rates, engagement, stage progression, product adoption, and influence on retention and expansion.
* Provide regular, data-backed recommendations to improve program effectiveness and to inform coverage and resourcing decisions.

**CS Ops & Leadership Partnership**

* Translate CS Leadership priorities and CS Ops workflows into programs and Gainsight builds quickly and with minimal hand-holding.
* Participate in regular syncs with CS Ops and Leadership to gather requirements, share updates, and surface dependency gaps before they cause delays.
* Enable CSMs to act on digital program outputs, and communicate program changes clearly.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 4–6+ years in Customer Success Operations, Digital/Scaled Customer Success, or lifecycle programs, including 3–5 years of hands-on Gainsight Building (or admin level type access).
* Proven experience designing, building, and managing Journey

jobs.title: Program Manager, Government
jobs.description:
For People is improving government digital services for the disadvantaged population. We work directly with government agencies to modernize software, systems, and platforms so that they better serve people.

**Your Impact**
---------------

Every month, hundreds of thousands of people go looking for facts about Medicare and Medicaid. They are researchers, reporters, policy staff, and health care providers. When the data is hard to find, a file is too large to post, or a column quietly changes its name between releases, their work slows down or goes wrong.

This project supports the website where the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) publishes that data for the public. It hosts a large catalog of datasets, lookup tools, and dashboards from across the agency, available for download, as interactive tools, and via a public API. As Program Manager, you will lead the team that builds and runs it. This is a hands-on role. You’ll facilitate partner meetings, support the team when they are blocked, and get into project details as needed to report clearly on the team’s progress. You’ll work elbow-to-elbow with the project’s technical and product leadership. You will learn about the work enough to identify and help mitigate delivery risks and hold the team accountable for what we promise to government partners.

This position is a full-time position **contingent** on For People being awarded a federal contract. If awarded, this position’s expected start date is February 2027.

**Our Culture**
---------------

For People is a team of humans. We place a significant amount of emphasis on positive work-life balance, setting healthy expectations, and making sure our loved ones are taken care of first. That means picking a child up from school during the day or going for a mid-day walk is okay!

This position is ***100% remote***. Our entire team is remote across the United States, from the West Coast to the East Coast. There will never be a return-to-office, as we have none! Occasional travel to CMS headquarters in Baltimore, MD (2-3 times per year) is required. These trips are infrequent and scheduled well in advance.

This full-time position's published base salary range is between **$100,000 and $160,000** annually. This band ranges across both the Program Manager and Senior Program Manager pay band, which will be determined based on relevant experience. All positions include generous benefits (e.g., For People pays 100% of Gold-tier employee health insurance premiums) and annual company profit sharing.

**Your Opportunities**
----------------------

On this project, you will be the delivery lead on a cross-functional team of about 15 people spanning engineering, design, user research, and support functions. The team may expand to up to 25 members in the future. As the Program Manager, you will:

* Build a collaborative and trusting team culture across all disciplines in the program
* Run agile practices including sprints, planning cycles, demos, and retrospectives, all of which include CMS stakeholders
* Coordinate with CMS offices that publish data on the public portal; share progress transparently and build positive working relationships with partner contracting teams
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks to project delivery
* Keep the program in line with contract, security, and accessibility requirements, including Section 508 and the site's Authority to Operate (ATO)
* Report status and outcomes to CMS and For People leadership, using live dashboards wherever possible and finding efficiency gains through automation
* Lead the handoff from the current contractor in your first few months so users see no disruption

**You Bring**
-------------

* A humble and caring attitude aligning with For People’s values: passion, fun, curiosity, sustainability, humility, and respect
* 8+ years of relevant experience in program or project management, including managing government contracts
* Degree in management, public administration, information technology, or a related field
* Experience with open data projects
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, with the ability to lead teams of 15 to 25 people as the contract grows
* Deep knowledge of agile product management principles
* Familiarity with collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub
* Ability to oversee all aspects of task order management including reporting, sprint planning, and project planning
* Experience facilitating stakeholder engagement across multiple government agency offices and data owners

**It Would Be Great If You Also Have**
--------------------------------------

* Experience working directly with CMS programs or data
* Experience with public websites built on Drupal
* Experience leading a contract transition from an incumbent team

**Some Fine Print**
-------------------

You will be working on a United States government platform, and they have a few basic requirements for contractors like ourselves. All work must be physically performed within the United States at all times. In addition, you must be a United States citizen and be able to pass a government-performed public trust background check.  
  
For People is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, and/or veteran status.

jobs.title: Customer Care Coordinator - Ice Cream Equipment
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

Slices Concession is North America's largest seller of refurbished ice cream and frozen drink equipment. We buy, remanufacture, and resell commercial machines nationwide. We're a small, hands-on team based in Gainesville, FL that moves fast and takes pride in running a tight operation.

**THE ROLE**

When a customer's machine has a problem, the first conversation sets the tone for everything that follows. We need one person to own that experience. You'll be the first voice customers hear, gather everything our technicians need, put each case in the right hands, and stay with it until the customer is up and running and happy. There's no formal customer care process yet, so you'll build it and then run it.

This is a remote, full-time role for an experienced customer service professional. It is not entry-level, and it is not sales. You'll start with one week of paid, on-site training at our headquarters in Gainesville, Florida.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Own the first call:** Answer incoming customer support calls professionally and promptly.
* **Run support intake:** Verify the customer and collect what our techs need, such as serial number, power source, mix, and photos, so every case is complete before it's handed off.
* **Handle first-level support:** Walk customers through our first-level checklist and simple fixes, which we'll train you on.
* **Route and escalate:** Send each case to the right technician or support level, and own it until it's resolved.
* **Keep customers informed:** Track parts and shipments and give timely updates on where things stand, ideally before the customer has to call and ask. You won't order parts. You'll make sure customers always know what's coming.
* **Answer order questions:** Give order status updates, help with shipping forms, and answer basic order processing questions.
* **Follow up:** Call a few days after delivery to catch setup problems early, and follow up after support to confirm the customer was taken care of.
* **Keep the record:** Log every case in Zoho CRM with clear notes, and close each one with a summary.
* **Build the system:** Create checklists, templates, and tracking tools that keep your caseload organized, and flag recurring problems to leadership.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of customer service or customer support experience, with a lot of phone work
* Proven ability to work independently and manage your own day without close supervision
* Trustworthy and discreet with customer and company information
* Calm, clear, and professional on the phone, including with frustrated customers
* Flexible and adaptable, someone who thinks on their feet when priorities change

**Description**

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Compliance Program Manager to join our CISO organization and help drive regulatory compliance, audit readiness and security governance across Keeper’s enterprise and federal environments. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL or El Dorado Hills, CA metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help strengthen the compliance and governance programs that support Keeper’s enterprise and public sector customers.

  

**About Keeper**

  

Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of federal IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices, and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. With industry-leading certifications, including FedRAMP High and GovRAMP Moderate Authorization, Keeper provides the security assurance public sector organizations require. Learn why federal agencies, including NASA and the DOJ, trust Keeper to defend against today’s sophisticated adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

  
  

**About the Role**

As a Senior Compliance Program Manager, you will manage complex compliance and governance initiatives across Keeper’s enterprise and regulated environments, including FedRAMP High and DoD IL5.

You will be responsible for coordinating audit cycles, continuous monitoring, POA&M remediation, third-party risk, policy governance, security training and supporting documentation. You will work closely with control owners and security leadership to translate regulatory requirements into clear plans, operational processes and accountable workstreams. This role requires strong compliance expertise combined with disciplined program management. You will maintain integrated plans, track risks and dependencies, drive cross-functional accountability and ensure documentation, training and evidence remain accurate, complete and audit-ready.

* Plan and manage compliance programs across audit cycles, continuous monitoring, POA&M remediation, policy initiatives and supporting documentation
* Establish program scope, milestones, dependencies, ownership and reporting across Security, Engineering, DevOps, IT and GRC
* Maintain integrated program plans, risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies and escalate blockers with clear recommendations
* Coordinate evidence collection, remediation tracking and control-owner activities for compliance and audit initiatives
* Maintain working knowledge of frameworks including NIST 800-53, FedRAMP High, DoD IL5, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS
* Partner with GRC and ISSO stakeholders on audit readiness, control documentation, remediation and continuous monitoring activities
* Monitor evolving regulatory and security requirements and assess potential business and operational impact

* Partner with Procurement, Legal and business owners on security requirements, contract terms and remediation expectations
* Maintain the third-party risk register and track remediation, risk acceptance and program metrics
* Author, maintain and govern information security policies, standards, procedures and control narratives
* Support System Security Plan documentation and other compliance-related technical documentation
* Develop and maintain information security training for employees and role-specific audiences including developers, administrators, privileged users and incident responders
* Manage training lifecycle activities including scheduling, learning management system administration, completion tracking, phishing simulation and audit evidence
* Develop training materials, job aids, scenarios and assessments in partnership with subject matter experts
* Measure and report training effectiveness using completion, assessment and behavioral metrics
* Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to validate technical information and maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation
* Translate complex technical and regulatory information into clear documentation for auditors, leadership and internal stakeholders
* Mentor team members and cross-functional partners on compliance processes and documentation practices
* Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or similar platforms to improve regulatory research, documentation, analysis, training development and workflow efficiency

**Requirements**

* 6+ years of progressive experience in information security compliance, governance, risk, audit, program management or a related field
* 3+ years of experience leading audits, assessments or compliance initiatives involving NIST 800-53, FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar frameworks
* Strong working knowledge of NIST 800-53 Rev. 5, NIST RMF, FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and related compliance requirements

And we don't stop there: we're creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.

Working here means you become part of a vision-driven team that's ready to tackle challenges and build cutting-edge solutions. We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person's unique skills and experiences. We'd love to hear from you—you might be just what we're looking for, whether in this role or another.

✨ Let's give businesses more time for what matters.

**Make your impact at a leading Fintech Company**

Led by the office of the General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer, BILL's Legal and Compliance function supports the company's growth and governance and builds trust with its customers, partners and regulators.

BILL is looking for a tech-savvy Sr. Privacy Program Manager to help scale privacy operations across the Legal and Compliance team. This person will own key parts of BILL's privacy program and work closely with Product, Engineering, Information Security, CX and Procurement.

The Sr. Privacy Program Manager reports to the Director, Legal and helps set and carry out BILL's privacy strategy. They will own privacy impact assessments, data subject requests and vendor privacy reviews. They will also look for ways to make the program more efficient, including through smart use of automation and AI tools.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Own and scale core parts of BILL's privacy and data governance program.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for privacy escalations, data subject requests, and privacy questions from across the company.
* Own the DSAR program end to end, including intake, tracking, fulfillment, metrics and process improvements in partnership with CX.
* Lead privacy impact assessments for new products, features and vendors that process personal data.
* Run privacy reviews for AI features and internal AI tool adoption, working with Legal, InfoSec and Product.
* Build and maintain data maps and records of processing, and stay current on company systems that hold personal data.
* Develop and deliver privacy training for employees and specific teams.
* Draft and maintain privacy policies, procedures and standard operating procedures.
* Monitor changes to privacy laws and regulations (CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, GDPR and emerging AI rules) and explain what they mean for the business.
* Find and roll out automation and AI tools that make privacy operations more efficient and scalable.
* Track and report privacy program metrics to Legal leadership.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 7+ years of experience in privacy, compliance or technology program management, including at least 4 to 5 years focused on privacy program operations (DSARs, PIAs/DPIAs, TIAs, ROPAs, vendor privacy reviews, cookie consent management, etc). Experience at a software, fintech or payments company preferred.
* Working knowledge of CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, GLBA, GDPR, HIPAA.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, GC.ai or Harvey) in daily work, for example to draft documents, summarize regulations, review contracts, or speed up assessments and request workflows. Candidates should be ready to share specific examples.
* Familiarity with privacy risks tied to AI**,** such as training data use, model inputs and outputs, and vendor AI terms, and experience assessing them.

### **About MD Integrations**

At **MD Integrations**, we partner with digital health brands to power clinical care at scale. We specialize in men's and women’s health, dermatology, endocrinology, and weight management, offering telehealth solutions that help patients receive expert, personalized care—all from the comfort of their home. **MD Integrations is an equal opportunity employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are unable to support US visa sponsorship at this time.

We are looking for a mid-level Customer Success Manager to join our expanding team!

**Overview**

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) at MDI serves as the primary point of contact for our partners (customers) from kickoff through onboarding, go-live, and support as they grow. This role ensures partners experience a smooth, guided implementation of MDI’s telehealth infrastructure while building long-term, value-driven relationships.

This position reports to the Director, Partner Success, is remote (US) and full-time, generally Monday - Friday core hours. This partner-facing role must be comfortable on video and calls with partners, and shifting early or late to support partner onboarding and success.

* Lead and project manage the full onboarding journey of new partners, from kick-off to go-live, ensuring clear milestones, proactive communication, and timely execution.

* Serve as a trusted advisor by providing market insights, best practices, and recommendations that align MDI’s solutions with partner growth goals.
* Manage and maintain consistent documentation on the customer lifecycle in internal systems, such as HubSpot, Asana, and other project and task management tools.

**Success in this role looks like**

* Partners achieve timely onboarding and confident go-lives with minimal friction. Communication is clear and consistent internally and externally.
* Partners feel consistently supported and guided through proactive, strategic communication through the post-sales cycle through onboarding and as they grow.
* MDI is positioned as a trusted advisor in helping partners scale their telehealth capabilities today and into the future.

**Qualifications**

* Experience by level:
* + **Associate-level** requires a minimum 1 year in Customer Onboarding, Customer Support, Customer Success or related customer-facing roles.

* Process- and project-oriented with a bias for action. Comfortable communicating clear deadlines, actions and risks with partners and internal leadership, driving toward aligned outcomes on behalf of the partner.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build trust with business leaders, executives, clinical and technical customers and colleagues, navigate complex needs, and translate feedback to internal teams.
* Empathy for early-stage startup partners and an understanding of healthcare concepts. Able to quickly understand the challenges of building a brand from the ground up and advocate for partner needs internally.
* Proficient with CRM and general technology tools (e.g., HubSpot, Slack), and able to utilize metrics like NPS, churn, and activation to inform decision-making.
* Quick study with new concepts and terminology such as key healthcare terminology and workflows to support partners. Bonus points for experience in healthtech or telehealth, and comfortable with basic clinical terminology and concepts.

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive Salary:** The targeted range for Associate-level is $50,000 - $60,000 per year; the targeted range for Mid-level is $65,000 - $75,000 per year. The CSM also has regular opportunities to earn outcome-based bonuses aligned with partner productivity goals.

65,000 - 75,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Product Enablement Lead
jobs.description:
Member Access Processing (MAP) is a trusted leader in payment processing solutions. We provide secure, efficient, and tailored services to financial institutions and businesses, enabling seamless transactions for their customers. With a focus on innovation, reliability, and customer satisfaction, MAP is committed to delivering cutting-edge technology and exceptional service in the ever-evolving world of payments. We pride ourselves on creating a positive, collaborative work environment where our employees can grow and make a meaningful impact.

**Overview**
============

The Product Enablement Lead is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and delivering product learning experiences that help credit unions and MAP employees confidently adopt, use, and optimize MAP products and supporting Visa DPS platforms. This role owns the product enablement content lifecycle, from evaluating the learning impact of new products and enhancements through curriculum development, delivery, measurement, and ongoing content maintenance.

The ideal candidate combines practical credit and debit card processing experience with knowledge of fraud and dispute operations, credit union core environments, instructional design, and adult learning. The role translates complex product and operational information into clear, practical, hands-on learning experiences that support client readiness, product adoption, operational consistency, and a strong client experience.

This role helps shift MAP’s learning model from presentation-based training to experiential enablement focused on system proficiency, workflow execution, troubleshooting, decision-making, and operational readiness. Success is measured not only by training delivery, but by whether learners can confidently perform the work, navigate applicable systems, troubleshoot common scenarios, and apply their knowledge after training.

**Role and Responsibilities**
=============================

**Product & Systems Expertise**
-------------------------------

* Maintain current, working knowledge of MAP products and services, including MAP Defense, MAP Data, card processing solutions, Visa DPS systems, and related operational tools.
* Monitor the Visa DPS product roadmap, release communications, product enhancements, and changes to existing products to determine training and enablement impacts.
* Partner with internal subject matter experts and Visa DPS resources to validate product information, workflows, dependencies, and client-facing guidance before training content is released.
* Understand how MAP and Visa DPS products interact with credit union core systems and processing environments and translate those differences into practical training guidance.
* Conduct ongoing research across MAP, Visa, and Visa DPS documentation to keep learning materials accurate, relevant, and current.
* Maintain practical knowledge of end-to-end credit and debit card processing, including authorization, clearing and settlement, transaction lifecycle, disputes, fraud, card servicing, transaction controls, and common exception scenarios.
* Develop working proficiency within relevant processor tools and environments sufficient to demonstrate workflows, recreate common scenarios, and guide learners through system-based exercises.
* Understand the relationship between issuer configuration, processor functionality, network requirements, core systems, and downstream operational impacts.
* Maintain knowledge of common payment terminology, transaction flows, response codes, authorization behavior, and processing concepts necessary to effectively train and support MAP employees and clients.
* Partner with operational subject matter experts to understand recurring support issues and incorporate those scenarios into training and reinforcement materials.

**Curriculum & Content Development**
------------------------------------

Health Quality and Stars (HQS) is responsible for improving health outcomes and advancing the care experience of members and provider partners through quality solutions. **Overview**

Abax Health is a healthcare technology company dedicated to enhancing the patient's financial experience through data-driven engagement. Our platform and tech-enabled services enable hospitals and health systems to identify patients at financial risk, personalize outreach, and optimize patient access operations. By combining empathy with innovation, we empower providers to improve outcomes and drive operational performance.

**Mission & Vision**

Ensure that every patient receives the care they need, when they need it. To be the trusted source of patient access innovation increasing revenue and transforming patient access and financial clearance by reducing administrative burdens, uncovering untapped revenue, and improving the financial and clinical outcomes for patients and health systems across the United States.

**Location:** United States | Remote

**Location Eligibility:** Candidates must currently reside in the United States. This role is not available to residents of California, New Jersey, New York, Montana, Hawaii, or Alaska, or of any U.S. territory.

**Summary**

The Patient Access Manager leads Abax Health’s remote Patient Access operations across assigned client partners. Reporting to the Director of Patient Access Operations, this role leads supervisors who oversee patient registration, insurance verification, prior authorization, and scheduling teams. The Patient Access Manager is also the escalation point for performance, employee relations, and client concerns.

You will turn operational data into decisions. Supervisors handle day-to-day issues and produce reports. You analyze those reports to determine whether SLAs are being met, what is driving trends, and when to escalate to the client. You will use both spreadsheets and AI tools for this work, including building your own dashboards and agents.

This role suits an experienced Patient Access leader who is energized by a growing company. You will support multiple clients and work alongside multiple leaders, and teamwork is central to how we operate.

* Participate in interviewing and selecting Patient Access staff and supervisors.
* Build a team culture grounded in collaboration, ownership, and commitment to patient care.

* Analyze supervisor-generated and system reports to evaluate SLA performance, productivity, quality, and work inventory.

* Use Excel and AI tools, such as Claude, to build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting agents.
* Prepare clear, data-driven performance reporting for Abax leadership and client partners.

**Client Partnership and Implementation**

* Serve as a primary operational contact for assigned clients.
* Partner with leadership during new client implementations and go-lives, setting expectations with staff and clients before launch.
* Participate in client meetings, performance reviews, and issue resolution.
* Support onboarding of new clients, workflows, and technologies as Abax grows.

**Operational Excellence**

* Maintain process documentation and best practices.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that improve patient experience and operational outcomes.
* Adapt to changing client and payer requirements.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Bilingual Team Support (bilingual candidates only, not required)**

* Serve as a Spanish-language resource for supervisors and staff working bilingual lines.
* Support quality review of Spanish-language patient interactions.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Required**

* High school diploma or GED.
* 3+ years of experience leading leaders, such as supervisors or team leads.
* 1+ year of direct supervisory experience in Patient Access.
* Experience overseeing teams that perform insurance verification, prior authorizations, and patient scheduling.
* Patient Access Manager experience or higher in a hospital, physician practice, healthcare call center, or similar patient-facing setting.
* Hands-on experience with electronic medical record (EMR) systems.
* Strong Excel and data analysis skills, with the ability to interpret reports and turn findings into action.
* Willingness to learn and use AI tools in daily work, including building dashboards and agents.
* Experience handling employee relations matters, including corrective action and performance improvement.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment with limited day-to-day oversight.

**Preferred**

**Front Desk / Guest Services & Spa Operations Associate**

**Piedmont Springs | Oakland, CA**  
**Part-Time | Evening Shifts: 4:00 PM–11:00 PM | Weekend Availability Required**

Piedmont Springs is looking for a friendly, dependable, energetic person to join our Guest Services team.

**First, an important note: this is not a sedentary receptionist position.**

Although every member of our Guest Services team works at the front desk, this is an **active, hands-on position**. Our staff rotate between front-desk responsibilities and helping operate the spa throughout the shift.

On any given evening, you may be checking in guests and answering phones one moment, then walking through the facility to reset spa rooms, handle towels and laundry, check restrooms and common areas, restock supplies, or assist with other operational needs the next.

**If you're looking for a job where you'll spend most of your shift sitting behind a desk, this probably isn't the right position for you.**

On the other hand, if you enjoy staying busy, moving around, helping customers, working independently, and having different things to do throughout your shift, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

**What You'll Do**

Our Guest Services staff are responsible for helping provide a welcoming experience for our customers while keeping the spa operating smoothly. Responsibilities include:

* Greeting customers and providing friendly, professional service
* Checking guests in and processing payments
* Answering phones and booking appointments
* Learning our services and helping customers select and schedule them
* Maintaining accurate reservations and customer information in our scheduling system
* Handling gift card purchases and redemptions
* Handling cash and maintaining an accurate cash drawer
* Walking first-time guests through the facility and explaining how their service works
* Monitoring appointment times and helping keep spa rooms running on schedule
* Resetting hot tub, sauna and steam rooms between guests
* Collecting, washing, drying and folding towels and other laundry
* Checking restrooms, guest areas and common areas throughout the shift and cleaning or restocking them as needed
* Restocking towels, water, tea, bathroom supplies and other items
* Performing routine water-chemistry checks and other basic spa-operating procedures after training
* Helping identify and report facility or equipment issues
* Completing evening closing procedures
* Pitching in wherever needed to keep the spa clean, organized and running smoothly

These responsibilities reflect the actual mix of customer-service and operating duties contained in Piedmont Springs' training manual, including room turnover, laundry, cleanliness, stocking, chemical checks and closing responsibilities.

**The Person We're Looking For**

We're less concerned about whether you've worked at a spa before than whether you have the right approach to work.

You'll probably enjoy this position if you:

* **Like staying busy** and prefer an active job to sitting in one place all day
* Naturally notice when something needs to be done and take care of it
* Are friendly and comfortable interacting with many different types of people
* Can remain calm and organized when several things need attention at once
* Take pride in keeping your workplace clean and presentable
* Are comfortable cleaning guest areas and restrooms when necessary
* Don't mind handling towels, doing laundry or performing other hands-on tasks
* Are dependable and understand that your coworkers are counting on you to show up for scheduled shifts
* Can follow detailed procedures while also using good judgment
* Are comfortable working independently without needing constant direction
* Pay attention to details, particularly when handling reservations, payments and customer requests
* Are willing to learn and accept feedback
* Have a genuine "pitch in and help" attitude

Previous customer-service, hospitality, retail, restaurant, spa or similar experience is helpful, but **attitude, reliability and work ethic matter more to us than having a particular background.**

**Schedule — Please Read Before Applying**

**We are currently hiring specifically for our evening team.**

Applicants must be able to regularly work:

**4:00 PM–11:00 PM**

**Weekend availability is required.**

Please apply only if evening shifts and regular weekend work fit your ongoing availability. We are looking for someone who can reliably commit to this schedule rather than someone seeking temporary evening availability.

**Physical & Work Environment**

This is an active position. Team members spend significant portions of their shifts **standing and walking throughout the facility**, including moving between floors and different areas of the spa.

The job also involves routine activities such as handling laundry and towels, bending and reaching while resetting or stocking areas, and working around the warm and humid environment associated with hot tubs, saunas and steam rooms.

Reasonable accommodations will be provided as required by law.

**About Piedmont Springs**

Piedmont Springs is a neighborhood spa in Oakland offering private outdoor hot tubs, sauna and steam, massage, skincare and other wellness services.

We've been serving the community for decades, and our goal is simple: provide customers with a welcoming, relaxing experience in a clean and well-run environment.

That takes more than someone sitting behind a counter. It takes a team of people who notice what needs to be done and are willing to do it.

UKON exists to help every business survive a cyberattack.  
Formerly known as FifthWall Solutions, we have grown from our foundation as a specialized cyber insurance wholesaler into a full-service cyber revenue partner for independent insurance agencies and managed service providers. We give our partners the technology, processes, carrier access, and expertise they need to deliver sophisticated cyber capabilities without the cost and complexity of building an internal cyber department.  
Today, our team works inside our partners’ books of business to identify uninsured companies, understand their risk, secure the right coverage, and help get more businesses protected. With access to more than 50 carriers and differentiated coverage options, including custom endorsements for emerging risks such as agentic AI, we help businesses understand what they are buying and how their coverage will respond when they need it most.  
We are building the AI-native operating system that will make this work scalable. Our platform brings together fragmented agency data, cybersecurity context, carrier appetite, quoting, communications, and workflows to shorten the distance between an uninsured business and a protected one.  
For us, AI-native does not mean adding a chatbot to an existing product. Every month, hundreds of thousands of people go looking for facts about Medicare and Medicaid. They are researchers, reporters, policy staff, and health care providers. When the data is hard to find, a file is too large to post, or a column quietly changes its name between releases, their work slows down or goes wrong.

This project supports the website where the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) publishes that data for the public. It hosts a large catalog of datasets, lookup tools, and dashboards from across the agency, available for download, as interactive tools, and via a public API. As Program Manager, you will lead the team that builds and runs it. This is a hands-on role. You’ll facilitate partner meetings, support the team when they are blocked, and get into project details as needed to report clearly on the team’s progress. You’ll work elbow-to-elbow with the project’s technical and product leadership. You will learn about the work enough to identify and help mitigate delivery risks and hold the team accountable for what we promise to government partners.

This position is a full-time position **contingent** on For People being awarded a federal contract. If awarded, this position’s expected start date is February 2027.

**Our Culture**

For People is a team of humans. We place a significant amount of emphasis on positive work-life balance, setting healthy expectations, and making sure our loved ones are taken care of first. That means picking a child up from school during the day or going for a mid-day walk is okay!

This position is ***100% remote***. Our entire team is remote across the United States, from the West Coast to the East Coast. There will never be a return-to-office, as we have none! Occasional travel to CMS headquarters in Baltimore, MD (2-3 times per year) is required. These trips are infrequent and scheduled well in advance.

This full-time position's published base salary range is between **$100,000 and $160,000** annually. This band ranges across both the Program Manager and Senior Program Manager pay band, which will be determined based on relevant experience. All positions include generous benefits (e.g., For People pays 100% of Gold-tier employee health insurance premiums) and annual company profit sharing.

**Your Opportunities**
----------------------

On this project, you will be the delivery lead on a cross-functional team of about 15 people spanning engineering, design, user research, and support functions. The team may expand to up to 25 members in the future. As the Program Manager, you will:

* Lead the handoff from the current contractor in your first few months so users see no disruption

**You Bring**
-------------

* 8+ years of relevant experience in program or project management, including managing government contracts
* Degree in management, public administration, information technology, or a related field
* Experience with open data projects
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, with the ability to lead teams of 15 to 25 people as the contract grows

* Familiarity with collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub

**It Would Be Great If You Also Have**
--------------------------------------

-------------------

You will be working on a United States government platform, and they have a few basic requirements for contractors like ourselves. All work must be physically performed within the United States at all times. * Manage and maintain consistent documentation on the customer lifecycle in internal systems, such as HubSpot, Asana, and other project and task management tools.
* Contribute to the development of key collateral, processes and defining standard expectations of work.

**Success in this role looks like**

* Partners feel consistently supported and guided through proactive, strategic communication through the post-sales cycle through onboarding and as they grow.
* MDI is positioned as a trusted advisor in helping partners scale their telehealth capabilities today and into the future.

* Process- and project-oriented with a bias for action. Comfortable communicating clear deadlines, actions and risks with partners and internal leadership, driving toward aligned outcomes on behalf of the partner.

new_jobs.title: Product Enablement Lead

Member Access Processing (MAP) is a trusted leader in payment processing solutions. We provide secure, efficient, and tailored services to financial institutions and businesses, enabling seamless transactions for their customers. With a focus on innovation, reliability, and customer satisfaction, MAP is committed to delivering cutting-edge technology and exceptional service in the ever-evolving world of payments. We pride ourselves on creating a positive, collaborative work environment where our employees can grow and make a meaningful impact.

**Overview**
============

The Product Enablement Lead is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and delivering product learning experiences that help credit unions and MAP employees confidently adopt, use, and optimize MAP products and supporting Visa DPS platforms. This role owns the product enablement content lifecycle, from evaluating the learning impact of new products and enhancements through curriculum development, delivery, measurement, and ongoing content maintenance.

This role helps shift MAP’s learning model from presentation-based training to experiential enablement focused on system proficiency, workflow execution, troubleshooting, decision-making, and operational readiness. Success is measured not only by training delivery, but by whether learners can confidently perform the work, navigate applicable systems, troubleshoot common scenarios, and apply their knowledge after training.

=========================================

The Stars Population Health Business Intelligence Lead will help the team move from reporting activity to generating actionable intelligence. Success in this role will be reflected in stronger population visibility, clearer performance accountability, faster identification of improvement opportunities, more rigorous evaluation of initiatives, and better-informed decisions that support Stars performance and member health outcomes.

**Description**

Health Quality and Stars (HQS) is responsible for improving health outcomes and advancing the care experience of members and provider partners through quality solutions. HQS is committed to caring for customers and delivering high plan quality as rated by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS).

The CMS Stars quality rating system evaluates Medicare Advantage and Prescription Drug Plans across measures that include preventive care screenings, health condition management, health outcomes, patient experience, and plan operations.

The Stars Population Health Business Intelligence Lead will provide advanced analytics, population insights, and reporting capabilities that enable the Stars Population Health Strategy team to improve performance among priority populations. The role will translate complex data into a clear understanding of performance drivers, member needs, program effectiveness, and opportunities for action across unpaneled members, new members, multi-gap members, and the Annual Preventive Visit enterprise strategy.

This role will partner across Stars and the enterprise to strengthen data availability, define meaningful performance measures, monitor outcomes, and create decision-ready insights. The role requires both deep technical expertise and strong business judgment, with the ability to influence stakeholders, establish shared accountability, and connect analytics directly to population-specific strategy and execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

new_jobs.title: Patient Access Manager (Remote)
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**

Abax Health is a healthcare technology company dedicated to enhancing the patient's financial experience through data-driven engagement. Our platform and tech-enabled services enable hospitals and health systems to identify patients at financial risk, personalize outreach, and optimize patient access operations. By combining empathy with innovation, we empower providers to improve outcomes and drive operational performance.

**Mission & Vision**

Ensure that every patient receives the care they need, when they need it. To be the trusted source of patient access innovation increasing revenue and transforming patient access and financial clearance by reducing administrative burdens, uncovering untapped revenue, and improving the financial and clinical outcomes for patients and health systems across the United States.

**Location:** United States | Remote

**Location Eligibility:** Candidates must currently reside in the United States. This role is not available to residents of California, New Jersey, New York, Montana, Hawaii, or Alaska, or of any U.S. territory.

**Summary**

The Patient Access Manager leads Abax Health’s remote Patient Access operations across assigned client partners. Reporting to the Director of Patient Access Operations, this role leads supervisors who oversee patient registration, insurance verification, prior authorization, and scheduling teams. The Patient Access Manager is also the escalation point for performance, employee relations, and client concerns.

You will turn operational data into decisions. Supervisors handle day-to-day issues and produce reports. You analyze those reports to determine whether SLAs are being met, what is driving trends, and when to escalate to the client. You will use both spreadsheets and AI tools for this work, including building your own dashboards and agents.

This role suits an experienced Patient Access leader who is energized by a growing company. At Abax, managers partner closely with leadership during new client implementations and go-lives, then stabilize and grow the team after launch. You will support multiple clients and work alongside multiple leaders, and teamwork is central to how we operate.

**Responsibilities**

**Leadership and Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop Patient Access Supervisors and the teams they support.
* Set clear expectations for performance, accountability, and professional growth.
* Serve as the escalation point for corrective actions, performance improvement plans (PIPs), and terminations, in partnership with HR.
* Participate in interviewing and selecting Patient Access staff and supervisors.
* Build a team culture grounded in collaboration, ownership, and commitment to patient care.

**Patient Access Operations Oversight**

* Oversee team performance in patient registration, insurance verification, prior authorizations, and appointment scheduling.
* Ensure standardized workflows are carried out consistently across assigned client programs.
* Identify workflow inefficiencies and put scalable process improvements in place.
* Ensure compliance with HIPAA, client requirements, SLAs, and organizational policies.
* Ensure staff recognize when a conversation needs a qualified medical interpreter, such as clinical or consent discussions, and follow established interpreter and language access procedures.

**Performance Reporting and Analytics**

* Analyze supervisor-generated and system reports to evaluate SLA performance, productivity, quality, and work inventory.
* Identify upward and downward trends, determine root causes, and build action plans with supervisors.
* Escalate risks to clients proactively, such as work inventory shortages or performance gaps.
* Use Excel and AI tools, such as Claude, to build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting agents.
* Prepare clear, data-driven performance reporting for Abax leadership and client partners.

**Client Partnership and Implementation**

* Serve as a primary operational contact for assigned clients.
* Partner with leadership during new client implementations and go-lives, setting expectations with staff and clients before launch.
* Participate in client meetings, performance reviews, and issue resolution.
* Support onboarding of new clients, workflows, and technologies as Abax grows.

**Operational Excellence**

* Maintain process documentation and best practices.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that improve patient experience and operational outcomes.
* Adapt to changing client and payer requirements.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Bilingual Team Support (bilingual candidates only, not required)**

* Serve as a Spanish-language resource for supervisors and staff working bilingual lines.
* Support quality review of Spanish-language patient interactions.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Required**

* High school diploma or GED.
* 3+ years of experience leading leaders, such as supervisors or team leads.
* 1+ year of direct supervisory experience in Patient Access.
* Experience overseeing teams that perform insurance verification, prior authorizations, and patient scheduling.
* Patient Access Manager experience or higher in a hospital, physician practice, healthcare call center, or similar patient-facing setting.
* Hands-on experience with electronic medical record (EMR) systems.
* Strong Excel and data analysis skills, with the ability to interpret reports and turn findings into action.
* Willingness to learn and use AI tools in daily work, including building dashboards and agents.
* Experience handling employee relations matters, including corrective action and performance improvement.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment with limited day-to-day oversight.

**Preferred**

* College’s degree.
* Fluency in spoken and written Spanish and English. This is preferred, not required. Candidates who list Spanish fluency will complete a language proficiency assessment during the hiring
